justification: Battle-axe CDC test judged lots against typed 3 m / 12 m constants with no route named; the granny flat space heuristic (our estimate) set not-buildable. Limits now come from cdc_eligibility_standards rows 87/88 (Sch 1 s2(1)(c), clause row 41115); messages name the CDC route, the measurement, the map source and the next step; the heuristic is a caution.

pre_impl.existing_data: What existing data/state does this interact with? [table/column or 'none']
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: What if existing data doesn't match assumptions? [specific failure]
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Will this apply to existing rows or only new? [mechanism]
pre_impl.external_source_error: (Critical only) What does external source return on error?
pre_impl.frontend_type: (Critical only) Does frontend type need updating? — checked against the existing housing-code loader pattern and callers
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: (Critical only) What does user see if this fails?

functions.name: applyBattleaxeLimits
functions.input: a detected battle-axe lot and the stored limits or null
functions.output: meets true/false/null, route-labelled messages, clause ref and PDF page
functions.if_none: limits null gives not_checked and a could-not-read message, never a pass

functions.name: loadBattleaxeLimits
functions.input: no arguments; it reads the two housing_sepp_sch1 rows from cdc_eligibility_standards
functions.output: access width and lot dimension with ref, quote and page
functions.if_none: returns null when a row is missing, stale, non-numeric or the query fails

functions.name: confirm_and_calculate
functions.input: lot area, detected dwelling footprint and request fields
functions.output: buildable flag unchanged by the space estimate; caution text naming CDC and DCP
functions.if_none: no caution when lot or dwelling area is missing

queries.purpose: read the two stored battle-axe CDC limits and the page of their source clause
queries.where_clause: code_name = 'housing_sepp_sch1' AND standard_type IN (two types) AND is_active AND stale_since IS NULL

break_it.scenario: the stored rows are deactivated or deleted while the page is being served to a user
break_it.what_happens: old code would still pass lots on typed numbers
break_it.repro: UPDATE cdc_eligibility_standards SET is_active=false WHERE code_name=housing_sepp_sch1 (test DB)
break_it.how: loader returns null; message says not checked; jest covers null limits

break_it.scenario: access way measured 2.9 m from the cadastre
break_it.what_happens: a hard fail or pass on map-precision geometry
break_it.how: within 0.2 m gives close-to-the-limit, meets null

break_it.scenario: a DA applicant reads below-minimum while the page is being served to a user
break_it.what_happens: they think the lot cannot take a granny flat at all
break_it.repro: battle-axe card on a 2.4 m handle
break_it.how: message says CDC is not available and a DA is assessed against the council controls

break_it.scenario: loadBattleaxeLimits SQL fails or returns no rows while the page is being served to a user
break_it.what_happens: a silent pass if the error were swallowed as true
break_it.repro: break the DB connection in a test
break_it.how: catch returns null which maps to not_checked; jest null-limits case

break_it.scenario: one of the two rows is stale or non-numeric
break_it.what_happens: a half-read limit could judge on one value and miss the other
break_it.how: loader requires both rows, finite and positive, else returns null and not checked

post_merge.manual_verify: GET /api/property/<battle-axe address> on the preview and read lotDimensions.battleaxe.complianceIssues

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/lib/cdc/battleaxe-cdc.test.ts lib/geometry/__tests__/lot-shape-analysis.test.ts && cd .. && python -m pytest tests/test_granny_flat_mutation.py -k cautions
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a typed limit returns, a missing row yields a pass, a message drops the route, or the space caution sets not-buildable
falsifiable_check.observed_red: re-adding granny_flat_buildable = False under the caution fails test_residual_area_cautions_but_never_blocks (1 failed)
